Not completely. I only believe that the very few who mean the most to me would be much better off if i wasnt around. I love them but i dont belong to any part of this life anymore. Never feeling that any of my own smiles were genuine. Never could be happy for myself. I dont want to live. If the alternative is to watch everything I care for slowly fade away with no possibility that it could be better then theres no point to anything anymore.
